title: Japan's constitution calls the Diet the highest organ of state power and the sole law-making organ
summary: Japan's constitution calls the Diet the highest organ of state power and the sole law-making organ.
body: Article 41 says the Diet shall be the highest organ of state power and the sole law-making organ of the state. The source says: "The Diet Article 41 The Diet shall be the highest organ of state power, and shall be the sole law-making organ of the State." Both 'highest organ' and 'sole law-making organ' are in the sentence. Cabinet orders and local rules are not described here.
